verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a commerce and payments platform, but the evidence shows only per-item agent tools (create_product, create_refund, create_order, accept_dispute_claim) and single-cart create/get endpoints. No documented batch or bulk endpoint or tool is shown, and list_disputes is a read listing, not a bulk action. Store Sync and partner catalog connections cover catalog syndication to AI shopping assistants, which is adjacent rather than a user-driven bulk operation across many items.
